entries.text: Good morning. Thank you for meeting me.
entries.easy_read:
I say hello.
I say thank you for the meeting.

entries.text: I am Ravi. I have two years of experience in packaging.
entries.easy_read:
I say my name.
I say what work I have done.

entries.text: My strength is that I am consistent and careful.
entries.easy_read:
I say what I am good at.
I do careful work every day.

entries.text: For example, I checked every order and made no errors last month.
entries.easy_read:
I give one real example.
Last month my work had no mistakes.

entries.text: I used to work slowly, so I practised until I became faster.
entries.easy_read:
Before, I was slow.
I practised a lot.
Now I am faster.

entries.text: I want this job because I enjoy careful, steady work.

entries.text: Last year our machine broke during a busy shift.
entries.easy_read:
I tell a story.
First I say what happened.

entries.text: My job was to keep the orders moving.

entries.text: I told my supervisor and moved to packing by hand.

I told my boss.
I packed by hand.

entries.text: We finished all the orders on time that day.
entries.easy_read:

entries.text: I work well in a team. I helped train two new joiners.
entries.easy_read:

entries.text: When it is busy, I take one task at a time and stay calm.
entries.easy_read:

entries.text: May I ask what a normal day looks like in this role?
entries.easy_read:

entries.text: Will there be training for the equipment?
entries.easy_read:

I want to learn the machines.

entries.text: Could you tell me about the team I would work with?
entries.easy_read:

entries.text: I have not used that machine, but I learn quickly and I follow instructions well.
